name: @enumeratio/evaluation
description: Controlling evaluation over @cortex-js/compute-engine: cancellable evaluate, cooperative deadlines (TimeConstrained), MemoryConstrained (enforced only in the isolated evaluator), and VerificationTest. ./node adds a worker_threads isolated evaluator, a reusable worker pool, and a stateful session; ./browser adds the same over dedicated/SharedWorker; both kept out of the main entry.

scripts.build: vp pack src/index.ts src/node.ts src/worker.ts src/session-worker.ts src/session-worker-core.ts src/browser.ts src/browser-worker.ts src/browser-session-worker.ts && node ../../../manifest/scripts/collect-declares.ts .
